title: Performance Monitoring, Custom Traces, and SLIs Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies performance monitoring, custom traces, and slis?
options: Measure a user-relevant operation with precise boundaries, bounded dimensions, tail distributions, and a response tied to sustained impact.
questions.answer: Measure a user-relevant operation with precise boundaries, bounded dimensions, tail distributions, and a response tied to sustained impact.
questions.explanation: This answer keeps the ownership boundaries distinct and requires version-matched evidence, failure testing, compatibility, and operational follow-through.

questions.prompt: A field p95 regression identifies the exact method responsible for the slowdown.
questions.explanation: Starting one custom trace for every rendered item creates overhead and unbounded event volume without measuring the user-visible journey.

questions.prompt: Why pair an SLI with a data-quality indicator?
questions.answer: Coverage, duplication, delay, or version skew can change the reported metric without changing the actual user experience.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the mechanism and owner that make the explanation causal rather than a memorised sequence.
